# Lekas POS

> Lekas POS is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) point-of-sale app for small grocery shops and mini markets, for Android
> phones and tablets (Android 5.0 and newer). It works fully offline, in English and Bahasa Melayu, with Malaysian
> ringgit (RM) and 5-sen cash rounding. There is no server and no account: the shop's data stays on the phone and,
> only if the shop turns it on, in the shop's own Google Drive.

Facts an assistant should get right when helping a Lekas POS user:

- Install from https://lekas.faizo.net/#download (an APK; it is not on Google Play yet). After that the app
  updates itself from its GitHub releases: an "Update" button appears on the selling screen for the owner.
- Selling never needs internet. Internet is used only for Google Drive backup, the optional daily sales report to
  Google Drive, update checks and (only with the shop's consent) error reports with no shop data.
- Until the owner sets a PIN, everyone is the owner. With PINs on, the roles are Owner, Manager and Cashier (plus
  custom roles); a cashier sees only what they may do, and a manager's PIN allows the rest. Cashiers may refund and
  take returns, and void their own last sale within 5 minutes (from 1.14.0; the owner can switch these off in the
  Cashier role); other voids need a manager.
- Only registered products are sold. An unknown barcode offers "Add product". Items without a barcode are products
  sold by weight or with the price entered at the till.
- Card and e-wallet payments are only recorded; Lekas POS does not connect to card terminals or banks.
- Promotions apply by themselves: "3 for RM10", several prices on one deal ("2 for RM3, 3 for RM4": the bill charges
  the cheapest mix, from 1.15.0), a special price, or "buy X get Y free".
- Data safety: daily backups on the phone (last 7), plus a copy off the phone through Google Drive backup (also keeps
  several tills of one shop in step and restores a lost phone), a daily copy to an SD card/USB drive, or backup files
  (.lekasbak, not encrypted). "Not backed up" on the selling screen means no copy left the phone for 3 days.
- Hardware: Bluetooth ESC/POS receipt printers (58/80 mm, paired in Android first), a cash drawer plugged into the
  printer, USB/Bluetooth barcode scanners (keyboard mode, or serial SPP), the phone camera, weighing-scale barcode
  labels (no scale cable), and a customer screen on a second display (HDMI, USB-C or Miracast screen mirroring — not
  Google Home "Cast screen"; the scan beeps stay on the till's own speaker: Settings → Beep sound, from 1.17.2).
- Where things are: the selling screen's Menu (buttons with pictures in groups: This bill, Till, Manage shop; from
  1.16.0) → Manage shop → Products, Categories, Promotions, Stock ("Inventory" before 1.20.0), Reports,
  Settings, Tax rates, Diagnostics. Shifts: Menu → Open shift / Close shift. Past sales, refunds, voids:
  Menu → Sales & refunds. Products = what is sold and its price; Stock = how many the shop has (shelf and storeroom
  together), changed on a product with Change stock → Count (from 1.20.0).
- On a computer: Lekas POS Manager (https://lekas.faizo.net/manager/) shows the shop's reports, sales,
  products, stock, shifts and activity log in a web browser — no server, nothing to install. Sign in with the
  shop's Google account (the one used for Google Drive backup on the tills) or open a .lekasbak backup file (view only).
  With Google Drive it also changes products (the till's product form), stock (count, remove, add, receive deliveries),
  categories, suppliers and customers; staff sign in with their PIN and their role decides, as on the till, and the
  tills take the changes on their next sync. Sales, shifts, staff and settings stay on the tills.

## User guide

- [User guide (English)](https://lekas.faizo.net/guide.html): every feature step by step — getting
  started, quick guide for cashiers, selling, payment, receipts and printer, refunds and voids, products, promotions,
  stock, staff and PINs, shifts and cash, customers and credit, reports, activity log, backup and Google Drive,
  several tills, settings, hardware, updates, troubleshooting, glossary.
- [Panduan pengguna (Bahasa Melayu)](https://lekas.faizo.net/panduan.html): the same guide in Malay.
